title: Notification regarding Provisional API Scores for Assistant Librarian

source.name: University of Kashmir, Jammu and Kashmir

text:
KEY LINES:
University of Kashmir against the Advertisement Notice No. 03 of 2026 dated 14-01-2026
19-06-2025 (A.N.) to 24-06-2025.

FULL TEXT:
University of Kashmir
NAAC Accredited Grade A++
Website:https://kashmiruniversity.net/recruitment/Main/Default.aspx
. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
NO T I CE
All concerned applicants who have applied for the post of Assistant Librarian in the
University of Kashmir against the Advertisement Notice No. 03 of 2026 dated 14-01-2026
are directed to check their provisional API score as per already notified criteria by login
through their user ID and password on the KU website (Recruitment Portal) w.e.f.
19-06-2025 (A.N.) to 24-06-2025.
S. No. Post Post Code Reservation
1.
Assistant Librarian
PGD-AL-12 Open
2. PGD-AL-13 SC
3. PGD-AL-14 ST-1
4. PGD-AL-15 ST-2
5. PGD-AL-16 Backward Area
6. PGD-AL-17 OBC
7. PGD-II-11 EWS
The scores are purely provisional and do not confer entitlement to eligibility for the said
post, which shall be determined separately. The concerned candidates are advised to
check the University website regularly for further updates as no individual intimation will
be made.
Sd/-
Deputy Registrar
(Recruitment)
No. KU/Rect./Notice/26
Dated: 18th June, 2026
